trends.name: Iran Strait of Hormuz Crisis
trends.summary: US-Iran ceasefire remains fragile with Strait of Hormuz blocked, tanker traffic disrupted for weeks/months, and Trump threatening military action. Goldman warns crude could spike to $115/year-end. UK PM Starmer negotiating reopening while Iran's nuclear chief rejects enrichment limits.

trends.name: Oil & Commodity Price Surge
trends.summary: Oil prices rallying on Middle East tensions and Strait blockade concerns. Commodity prices broadly rising amid energy disruptions and El Niño weather risks to food costs. Goldman's $115 crude forecast signals further upside potential for energy sector.

trends.name: US Economic Data Beat Estimates
trends.summary: US Economic Surprise Index reaches 0.338, highest since October 2023, signaling consistent data beats vs. expectations. This has risen +0.74 points since July 2025, suggesting stronger-than-expected economic resilience and potential Fed policy implications.

trends.name: S&P 500 Bullish Technical Breakout
trends.summary: S&P 500 smashes back above two key moving averages in rare display of strength. Jim Cramer's market rally commentary suggests this breakout reveals undervalued buying opportunities. Historical patterns suggest momentum may continue despite geopolitical headwinds.

trends.name: Inflation Reports & Fed Rate Path
trends.summary: Inflation reports due with market impact on Fed's rate path. Nick Timiraos signals Iran war has already impacted rate trajectory. Economic surprise index strength combined with oil volatility creates uncertainty for Q2 inflation prints and central bank policy.

trends.name: OpenAI IPO & Retail Share Allocation
trends.summary: OpenAI CFO confirms IPO preparations with retail investor share allocation planned. Major AI narrative shift as company prepares public markets entry, signaling confidence in valuation and market conditions amid broader AI sector dynamics.

trends.name: Prediction Markets Surge (Kalshi Dominance)
trends.summary: Kalshi prediction market platform shows explosive growth with 91% share of US prediction market. Weekly trading volume surged dramatically over past year, signaling retail/institutional shift toward event-based betting on policy outcomes and geopolitical events.

trends.name: Constellation Brands Withdraws 2028 Guidance
trends.summary: Constellation Brands (Modelo, Corona maker) withdraws 2028 guidance citing uncertainty, likely tied to Mexico-related trade/tariff risks or US-related macro headwinds. Signals broader corporate caution on forward guidance amid policy uncertainty.

trends.name: Dividend & Income Strategy Repositioning
trends.summary: SCHD-inspired dividend growth strategies gaining attention as investors seek stable income amid market volatility. Municipal bond valuations, dividend aristocrats, and value plays (EZU, Brookfield Infrastructure) becoming focal points as rate trajectory remains uncertain.

trends.name: Europe Economic Weakness (Spain Industrial Output)
trends.summary: Spain industrial production missed estimates (-0.1% M/M vs +0.2% est) with annual decline of -1.3% YoY. Signals broader European economic softness and potential drag on global growth, relevant for multinational earnings and FX dynamics.

trends.name: Cancer-Treating Bacteria Breakthrough
trends.summary: Scientists developed bacteria that devours cancer tumors from inside out, representing potential paradigm shift in oncology treatment away from traditional pharma drugs. Could reshape biotech/healthcare sector investment thesis and valuations.

trends.name: NATO & US Military Realignment
trends.summary: US plans to move troops out of NATO members deemed unhelpful to Iran war effort, stationed in supportive countries instead. Trump's Greenland/NATO rhetoric deepens rift, creating geopolitical uncertainty and potential defense spending/contracting implications.
